title: [CQ-C11] Context integration and hardening
description:
Objective: Verify stale context, new helpers, incomplete semantic analysis, session deltas and recipe mismatch across roles.

Deliverable: Context integration and hardening. This is task C11 of the approved full CQ rollout; consume this contract, not the whole reference document.

Scope boundaries: implement this behavior and its regression tests only. Later activation, other platform/client consumers and other task behaviors remain out of scope unless named here. Approved full CQ-01–CQ-08 rollout from the interactive implementation plan (2026-10-24). CQ-01 is already landed. Use original Moe source; daemon owns state, wrappers own host Git writes. User selected Moe-provisioned LOCAL Linux VMs (not cloud CI), coding/QA and checks isolated, and exact designated LOCAL BRANCH delivery. Strong profile stays disabled until isolation, evidence and client gates pass. Preserve legacy behavior and existing dirty bytes. Never directly edit .moe. No second revision authority, scheduler, graph database or native memory database.

Verification command (fresh, exit0 required): cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test

Dependency aliases (wired by Moe task ids after import): C10.
definitionOfDone: Zero planner calls occur only for valid reuse/eligible recipe paths.
No approval or scope boundary is bypassed.
Fresh verification `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` exits0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.

implementationPlan.description:
Write packages/moe-daemon/src/__e2e__/plannerBoundaries.e2e.test.ts for DoD2 and DoD3. A planner call is counted as an architect claim_next_task({statuses:['PLANNING']}) that returns the task.

Zero planner calls occur ONLY on these paths:
- (a) C07 reuse. The plan is approved, the row re-enters PLANNING from BACKLOG, and an unrelated commit lands. The row resumes WORKING with approvedPlanRevision unchanged and never re-stamped, and the architect claim never returns it.
- (b) An eligible C09 recipe through instantiateRecipe under TURBO. The row reaches WORKING with zero architect claims.

A planner is REQUIRED (the claim returns the task, with the reason visible in planReuse or the fallback system message) for:
- C07 refresh or reassess: an affected file changed, or an anchor or assumption changed;
- C07 replan: entry from WORKING or REVIEW;
- every recipe fallback.

Approval and scope boundaries (DoD3):
- A CONTROL recipe instantiation stays AWAITING_APPROVAL with no approvedPlanRevision.
- SPEED approves only after its delay.
- A DoD or contract change advances planRevision, so the row is not reused.
- The 'moe-recipe' identity is NOT_ALLOWED for an MCP caller, and a forged recipeInstance is stripped.
- assessPostpatch refuses extra edits.
- A delta never crosses a session or attempt boundary.

Fix forward, only where the e2e tests expose a real defect in a prerequisite.
- Make the smallest fix in the owning module. Call moe.declare_files on it first, and keep or add a regression in the e2e file.
- Never weaken an assertion, and never work around a defect inside a test.
- A fix over about 30 lines, or one that changes a contract, gets moe.report_blocked naming the owning task instead.
- Error handling must stay fail-closed.
- Record every fix, with its owning task, in the step note.

comments.author: architect-4c57a52b
comments.content:
Docs and integration hand-forward from CQ-C01 (task-fef5ca57, plan rev 1). Verify against what landed before writing anything.

Default and full get_context task reads gain `packetManifest`:
- `version`.
- `provenance`: task {id, planRevision}, epic, project, and candidate (when one exists).
- `sections`: entries {path, mandatory, status (C02's served|truncated|omitted|missing), reason, count}.
  - MANDATORY_SECTIONS are never role-trimmed or truncated.
  - Omissions are explicit: role-trim, compacted comments/chat, capped commits/siblings/rejections.
- `complete`.
- `limitations`, sorted. 'no-repository-source' stays until C10 serves C02's provider.
- `budget`: {limitChars, mandatoryChars, status within|overflow, requirement expand|restructure}.

There is also a new optional `packetBudgetChars` input (1000..250000, default 100000), refused when invalid, never clamped.

The manifest sits inside F06's packetId digest and never grants approval.

For C11, document all of this in docs/MCP_SERVER.md (get_context) and docs/SCHEMA.md. C06 (deltas) and C10 (targeted guidance) build on these section paths and codes.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
1. Put the docs sweep inside C11. Rejected for size: e2e tests of about 350 lines plus docs of about 120 lines would exceed the 400 net cap. The docs became C11a (task-95b610e3, order 248, docs only), which C11 dependsOn, so the final review still covers them.
2. Wiring activation into C11 (the assessPostpatch call site, epoch stamping, providers in packets). Rejected: C11's scope line excludes later activation. They are listed as open items for the M05/M06 rollout.
3. Per-feature e2e files. Rejected: two files grouped by DoD keep the matrix reviewable and within the cap.
planningNotes.risks:
- Many prerequisites are unlanded: if one is missing an entry point, call report_blocked on it; never stub it.
- Flaky timing: SPEED uses a short delay plus vi.waitFor, and Git commands use bounded timeouts.
- WSL: run the gate only in a Linux-native snapshot.
- Size: two test files at or under 400 net lines, plus small fixes.
- Do not edit .moe: .moe/recipes.json exists only in temp repos.
